lcc_original: 永恆主見人類在地上壞透了，人類心思終日所計謀的、沒有別的、只是壞事；
notes: 壞透了 merges two Hebrew lexemes — 罪惡 (WH07451, רָעַת) and 很大 (WH07227, רַבָּה) — into one idiomatic phrase; both SNs attach to the whole unit
WAH03588 (כִּי, 'that') remains implicit {<WAH03588>} because LCC, like UNV, uses direct object construction without an explicit complementizer
WAH03605 for וְכָל ('and every', modifying יֵצֶר) has no explicit LCC correlate and is marked implicit; the second WAH03605 (כָּל before הַיּוֹם) attaches to 終
心思 covers WH04284 (מַחְשְׁבֹת, thoughts) and WH03820 (לִבּוֹ, heart); 所計謀 carries WH03336 (יֵצֶר, inclination/impulse)
Second 人類 is LCC's subject-repeat for literary clarity with no Hebrew counterpart at that position — left unannotated
沒有別的 renders WH07535 (רַק, only); 只是 is LCC elaboration without a separate Hebrew word; 壞事 carries the second WH07451 (רַע, evil)
